name: Judder
description: Stepped offsets rather than smooth ones, so the field jerks instead of sliding.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 14%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transform: translateY(@calc(@round(@sin(1.3 * @i) * 2) * 14)%); transform: translateY(@calc(@round(@sin(1.3 * @i) * 2) * 14)%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
